end.summary:
Asha practised predicting whether objects roll, slide, or stack.
Anika showed understanding that curved surfaces roll, including in new examples.
Flat-faced objects sliding was practised; predictions were right in 2 of 3 attempts and need more checking.
Flat tops and bottoms stacking was practised; the prediction was not yet steady.
The idea that a round part can never be stacked remained at the last sighting; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha used balls, bottles, boxes, glasses, and everyday examples to practise noticing curved and flat surfaces. Anika showed the rolling idea with new examples; sliding and stacking predictions still need more practice. The mix-up about round objects never being stackable was not corrected after it was last seen. At home, ask Anika to sort safe objects into roll, slide, or stack and explain which surface helped.
